flags.note: Screenshot is at 0% progress with all dots black; the colour legend (teal/blue) only applies late in training, so the first view doesn't show what colours mean.
'distance 1.7' has no scale or units on the 2D plot, so a newcomer can't tell whether 1.7 is close or far.
Opening state shows empty score/softmax columns and faded value dots; unclear what the blank cells and faint circles mean until stepping through.
